aboutIntro.body: I'm Monson Sunny, a UI/UX Designer associated with Caxita Tech Solutions. With a background in front-end development, I design mobile apps and web experiences that are clear, usable, and pleasant — from early flows to polished, developer-ready interfaces.

about.title: UI/UX Designer with a background in front-end development, focused on mobile apps and web experiences.
about.body: I'm Monson Sunny, a UI/UX Designer associated with Caxita Tech Solutions. My work spans product discovery flows, dashboards, booking experiences, and marketing pages — always aiming for interfaces that are intuitive, consistent, and easy to build. Add project case studies, experience, and contact details anytime through the Studio.

faqs.q: What does a project with you look like?
faqs.a: We start with goals and user flows, move to wireframes, then polished UI in Figma with prototypes. You get organized files that are ready for development handoff.
Figma for interface design, wireframes, prototypes, and design systems — plus standard handoff practices for developers.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to start?
faqs.a: A short intro about your product, any existing content or references, and the screens or flows you have in mind. Everything else can be shaped together.

faqs.q: How can I see more of your work?
faqs.a: Browse the selected projects on this site, and ask for the Behance profile link — it can be added here through the Studio.
